title: Daydream - Rooftop fire pit & skyline views
description:
Designer-furnished, super-hosted luxury in the heart of The Gulch. Walk or ride 3 min to Broadway, dining and nightlife, then unwind on your private rooftop with skyline views.
4 spacious bedrooms & 3.5 baths
Chef’s kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, 2-car garage
Professionally cleaned & managed
We own eight adjacent homes—ask about pairing for larger groups.
Ready for an unforgettable Nashville stay? Book your dates while they’re still open!

The space
Highlights:
• We own 8 units next to each other, larger groups please reach out.
• Private roof top deck with views, projector, grill and seating
• Free parking in the 2 car garage
• Walk Score 85 (walk to Gulch, cafes, dining, shopping, nightlife)
• Fully equipped + stocked kitchen
• 5 minute drive to downtown Nashville

Perfect for larger groups or multiple families looking to travel together. Daydream is equipped with custom kitchens and professional appliances, designer spa like baths with Italian tile and faucets, incredible lighting, soaring ceilings, unique and beautiful wall treatments, and rooftop decks with 360 degrees views of downtown. Book now and make this the choice for your next group trip or work getaway to Music city. 

Bed Setup for this home:

★ Master Bedroom (3rd Level): King Bed with suite Bathroom
★ 2nd Bedroom (3rd Level): King Bed- full bathroom right outside the room
★ 3rd Bedroom (3rd Level): 2 twin bunk beds - full bathroom right outside the room shared with 2nd bedroom
★ 4th Bedroom (1st Level): Queen with full bath right outside the bedroom
★ 2 cots stored on site

Unwind Luxury Vacations is the professional management company for this home, and committed to curating your 5-star experience.

Guest access
Full access to the unit plus rooftop lounge, garage, grill, wifi. Rooftop projectors are stored in the 3rd floor bedroom.
